data.one_liner: Smooth on-tap shrink and grow bounce animations for Flutter widgets
data.what_it_does: Allows you to wrap any widget with a touch interaction that applies a smooth scale animation, color highlight, and optimized behavior such as auto-canceling on scroll or when moving the touch outside the area.
use_when: You want to add tactile feedback like shrink/grow animations to custom widgets or cards
You need touch interactions that automatically handle scroll cancellation and prevent rapid multiple touches
avoid_when: You need complex physics-based gesture simulations like Rive or advanced custom graph motions
strengths: Automatically detects parent scroll events to cancel bounce animations
Automatically discovers child widget border radius for highlight clipping
Prevents multiple and rapid simultaneous touches by default
weaknesses: Limited to specific shrink/grow bounce and highlight interaction mechanics
Cannot assign both onTap and onLongPressUp simultaneously

alternatives.name: flutter_animate
alternatives.why_pick_it: For a comprehensive animation library handling a wide range of entrance, exit, and effect animations beyond simple touch bouncing.
